room_rent.note: Up to ₹5L SI: 2% of SI max ₹5,000/day; ₹6-10L SI: max ₹10,000/day; ₹15-20L SI: max ₹20,000/day. Proportionate deduction on other expenses if room limit exceeded.

icu.note: Up to ₹5L SI: 5% of SI max ₹10,000/day; ₹6-10L SI: max ₹20,000/day; ₹15-20L SI: max ₹40,000/day.

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment applies to every admissible claim amount for all insured persons.

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower. Modern/advanced treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI.

initial_waiting.note: Illness claims excluded for first 30 days; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 48 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month wait for cataract, hernia, piles, hydrocele, benign tumours, etc. 48-month wait for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduces at same rate if claim made. Maximum 50% of SI.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; Appendix I lists 116 specific procedures.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals.

organ_donor.note: Policy wording does not mention organ donor expense cover.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical consumables listed under excluded expenses (Annexure-A lists).

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded; territorial limit is India only.

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, no look-back on claims except fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual premium renewal. 15 days for instalment premiums.

free_look.note: Free-look applies at inception only, not on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity credit.

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, obesity surgery (conditional), refractive error <7.5D, treatment outside India, adventure sports (professional)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording.
